clues: This city sits on the north coast of East Java. It is in Indonesia, by the sea.
From July to September, strong dry winds blow here. They help mango trees spread pollen and may make the fruit taste great.
Dutch rulers ran this place in the eighteen hundreds. It was a rich hub for sugar made to sell abroad.
This city is famed for sweet mangoes. The local name for them is mangga manalagi.
Its motto is one short word, Bestari. It stands for clean, healthy, tidy, safe, neat, and pretty.
